# Mobile App EH — working rules

Bare React Native (0.86.x, TypeScript). **No Expo** in any form (no `expo-*` packages, no EAS, no prebuild).
**No hand-written native code** (no Swift/Obj-C/Kotlin): only files generated by the RN template exist under `ios/` and `android/`; everything native comes from libraries. If a library does not support RN 0.86 / New Architecture, pick another or ask.

iOS first; Android is scaffolded but not built or tested yet. Keep JS platform-agnostic: all native access goes through `src/platform/*` adapters.

## Migration plan
Plan: `C:\Users\raksh\.claude\plans\in-the-folder-mobile-twinkly-rose.md`.
- Phase 0: scaffold (done) · Phase 1: pages on fixtures (1A UI kit, 1B Dashboard + Closing this week, 1C Tenders, 1D Projects, Alerts tab done; 1E New tenders + Bookmarks and 1F Downloads / document viewer / ZIP browser and 1G More (Account, Appearance, reminders, app lock, clear cache, sign-in) done. Phase 1 pages complete; next Phase 2A) · Phase 2: logic (parts 2A–2H).
- Portal selection is a dropdown (`PortalSelect`, Dashboard and Tenders; no "All" on Tenders). Search field and the star/ribbon bookmark toggle share a neutral bordered field look; the toggle turns solid accent when on. Solid style has no drop shadows and every Solid card has a hairline border.
- New tenders opens from a "new tenders" alert (`newTenderIds` on the alert); Downloads opens from the More tab. The Bookmarks screen exists but has no entry point since it was removed from More (Dashboard tile and the Tenders bookmark toggle cover it). Downloads: ready PDFs open the viewer, ZIPs open the archive list (PDF inside opens the viewer); requesting a tender document adds a "Requested" row. Viewer body is the `PaperPage` placeholder until Phase 2F.
- More tab: Account (read-only email, change password, sign out), the Dark/Light/System control sits directly on the More tab; "Colours & style" opens rounded-square accent swatches ("Accent: Ink"), base colour swatches ("Base colour: White"; hidden in Glass) and the Solid/Glass slider, Deadline reminders toggle (moved from Alerts), Downloads, App lock (+ Lock now), Clear local cache sheet. Sign out goes to SignIn; signing in resets to Tabs.
- Navigation: 5 bottom tabs (Dashboard, Tenders, Projects, Alerts, More). The Dashboard header also has a bell that switches to the Alerts tab. Tenders: Organisations left, Tenders right; a bookmark button (star for tenders, ribbon for organisations) sits before the search field; bookmark icons use the accent colour.
- Web gotcha: SVG gradient ids must be unique per instance (`useId`), and blur layers need `zIndex: -1` in the web shim, or glass renders wrong on web.
- Every new screen must render in both Solid and Glass (and dark). In the browser preview a control panel (left of the phone) flips style, mode, accent and base live.
- Layout rules: the tab bar is docked to the bottom edge and both sides (full width, top hairline, home-indicator area inside it) and never scrolls (content scrolls behind it); every `Screen` puts a scrim over the top safe area so scrolled content never runs under the clock/battery row. The browser preview frames a tall iPhone (430 x 932, insets 59/34) with a simulated status row.
- Dashboard order: header, calendar strip (slides week by week; only today has a tall, narrow tile, very translucent in Glass; one accent dot = 1 tender closing that day, accent + grey dots = 2 or more), Needs attention, stat tiles (Tenders synced, Active projects, Orgs|Tenders bookmarked, Closing this week; all tappable, compact padding), Pipeline Snapshot (full width: amount, a ring for % of bookmarked value in preparation, Bookmarked and Active bars), four equal stat tiles (Tenders synced, Bookmarks, Active projects, Closing this week), Next Deadline (full width, ring + Closing soon bar), full-width Sync bar, Upcoming deadlines (Critical/Soon/Later with coloured left stripes). No portal selector on the Dashboard. Cards use the `md` drop shadow in Glass only.
- Browser preview on Windows: `npm run dev` (react-native-web + Vite in `web/`, preview only).
- Logic is ported from `../Mobile App RN/src/lib` (read-only reference).

## Conventions
- Styling: `StyleSheet` + `useTheme()` tokens from `src/theme` (accent, White/Paper base, Solid/Glass, dark). No hardcoded colours in screens.
- Fonts: `fonts.*` from `src/theme` (Plus Jakarta Sans, IBM Plex Mono).
- Gradients: `src/components/ui/Gradient` (react-native-svg). Glass: `@react-native-community/blur`.
- Icons: `lucide-react-native`.
- Bundle ID during migration: `com.raku.s0995.bidmanager-mobile.eh` (switch to production ID at cutover, Phase 2H).
- From MacinCloud, only push changes from `Mobile App RN` (root CLAUDE.md) unless that rule is extended to this folder.
